column1: # Upstream GitHub ruleset recipes this repo's own rulesets are modeled on.
# There is no local copy for any of these yet - that's deliberate. The point
# of the first run of ruleset-drift-check.yml is to prove the fetch actually
# reaches these URLs and reports real content, before anyone commits to a
# specific baseline to diff against. Once a local copy is added for a row,
# the workflow starts comparing it against upstream on every scheduled run.
